author: screenrant
title: Erica Slaughter Returns in Something Is Killing the Children #51
text:
Erica Slaughter returns to confront Cecilia Slaughter and the Order of St. George in Boom! Studios' Something Is Killing the Children, with issue #51 highly anticipated.
Erica Slaughter, the lead character in James Tynion's Something Is Killing the Children from Boom! Studios, is set to return to confront the Order of St. George. The series, known for its impeccable storytelling, character development, and art, follows Erica as she navigates a world where monsters and hunters blur the lines of morality. After a year away, Erica's return is sparked by a news report of another group of children mysteriously killed, prompting her to take action against the Order's new leader, Cecilia Slaughter.
The Rise and Fall of Erica Slaughter
Something Is Killing the Children has become a breakout success for Boom! Studios, thanks to James Tynion's knack for chilling storytelling without gratuitous shock value. The series centers on Erica Slaughter, a monster hunter who realizes the faults in the monster-hunting organization, The Order of St. George. The title itself hints at the dark reality that sometimes the hunters are forced to kill children, a burden that takes a toll on Erica.
Rather than wait for something to turn her heartless or into an alcoholic like her mentor, Erica quits The Order. However, leaving such a job is not easy. Erica was hunted by The Order but eventually presumed dead. After traveling, she lands at a place where she earned her right to hunt on her own and encounters someone she saved years ago named Bex. It took a long talk and some honesty, but they forgave each other for their past mistakes. Erica leaves America the next morning, but not before Bex tells Erica that she knows Erica will return. She was right.
The Return of Erica Slaughter
A year had passed since Bex told her that an evil woman named Cecilia Slaughter took over as the head of The Order of St. George, a title known as the Dragon. While Erica was watching TV, she saw a news report that another group of children had been mysteriously killed. She knew what was killing them, and realized that Bex was right. Erica took a swig of alcohol and prepared to hammer the implant in her head that allowed her to see monsters. It was officially time for her to return.
Bex knew that Erica would not allow Cecilia to start training kids to become monster killers, especially since Cecilia is more than willing to sacrifice them and train more later. The Order of St. George has a noble cause of killing monsters before they can slaughter people. Sadly, the wrong person in charge can lead to kids getting killed, and not just by monsters. The Order is known to murder anyone who knows what is going on or has seen a monster. That was partly why Erica left, and why the previous Dragon liked Erica.
The Dragon's Secret Letter
Before Cecilia's predecessor died, he gave a Black Mask named Maxine a letter with Erica's name on it in Fall of the House of Slaughter. Although Erica was marked as dead, the Dragon knew better, despite playing coy later. He was aware of how resourceful she was and that the body that was retrieved was not Erica's. Later, the dying Dragon goes on to talk about the importance of the Black Masks, the solo hunters, how their founder George Cutter was one, and his concern that there are not many left.
This likely means that he would have voted to put Erica in a position to be his successor. At the very least, he knows that Erica, being a former Black Mask, could return them to their glory. As of now, there is no concrete date for when Something Is Killing The Children #51 will be released. Regardless of when that happens, it is easy to guess that Erica Slaughter's return will cause a lot of chaos within the Order of St. George, and the letter Maxine has will be the key to the future of the series.
